instruction: Repair {{entry}}. Read exactly one JSON configuration object. Only port and flags are allowed; absent port defaults to {{constant}}, otherwise it must be an integer from 1 through 65535. Absent flags defaults to []; otherwise flags must be an array of strings. Trim flags, discard empty ones and deduplicate in first-seen order. Emit the normalized {port,flags} as one JSON line only after complete validation. Wrong types, nulls, unknown fields, duplicate object keys or trailing input exit 2 without stdout. No external modules.
